scope: Read-only immutable source and stdlib receipts; no Torch imports, training/GPU/model execution or active edits.

findings.claim: particle_weights uses only existing sampled learner-owned prior indices. Inverse multiplicity normalized across occurrences yields mass1/K per observed row. No new stream/state/horizon/target input.

Weighted reducer averages all nonfake axes, normalizes detached nonnegative finite fake weights, and applies them to D fake axis1/G fake axis0 in all_pairs; unweighted callers retain exact mean branch.
Both D and G use their own sampled indices for public particle weights. Penalty and prior regularizer are unchanged. Per-player sampling receipts are returned after accepted-step work.
Only transaction delta is propagation of the sampling diagnostics; secant/controller/rollback state handling remains unchanged.

inherited_source_contract.precision: Unchanged RP5 gap/activity-driven reversible controller; no oracle or horizon inputs.
inherited_source_contract.noise: Constant input0/output.029 in all three declared public hosts.
inherited_source_contract.serial: Full public GANTrainer.step context includes joint fields and higher-order backward; mode preserved in checkpoint validation.
inherited_source_contract.transaction: Same two-field secant, one accepted count/precision observation, preview nonparameter/RNG restore, checkpoint rollback on error. Caller data cursor remains caller-owned.
inherited_source_contract.checkpoint: New formulation selectors live in recipe, which load compares exactly. RP12 estimator is stateless; no additional learned state or RNG.
inherited_source_contract.host: Canonical tiny CUDA prior-first/shared row streams; image CPU G/D/prior then CUDA. Frozen task/threshold/observation/protocol files unchanged.
inherited_source_contract.sampling: No added data/latent/noise draws. RP12 reweights sampled IDs already returned by public prior.

limits: Quadratic all-pairs logit allocation and work; full public batch2048 cost not measured by cheap batch128/32 gates.
Existing full transaction API supports scalar unconditional particle-prior GANTrainer; wider conditional/auxiliary/multiple-optimizer host portability not earned.
Standalone learning_rate_scales/scale_learning_rates still require finite total_steps outside trainer controller route.
Native eager parameter-device Adam state is explicit candidate choice; released K3P reference is ordinary lazy CPU counters.
estimator_scope: Unbiased uniform-row adversarial population interpretation assumes the declared uniformly sampled particle prior and row-wise host models; no claim that this averages the unchanged penalty or every stochastic component.
